beats.headline: Don't come in last
beats.text: Five thousand five hundred and one crawlers reach the tenth floor. Three in four of the survivors took an exit deal, and Carl is glad of every one of them. Justice Light's last message arrives from a dead man: I am not sorry. The Nothing is broken, and the club on the eighteenth floor is inside an awake Scolopendra. Donut becomes an Assassin of Sekhmet, and Khepri promptly announces a death cult in her name. Then a naga called Princess Chandra, Esquire, informs Donut that she is her attorney now, that Donut is under a conservatorship with Carl as guardian, and that she has married Carl under an old naga widow's law and seized the Posse's accounts. Each team has a garage, a gremlin mechanic named Hedy, and a vehicle chosen by a wheel. Theirs is a Big Shot Chicken food truck with a giant plastic tommy gun on the roof. Every heat is a road race against teams of NPCs, and Prepotente sees the trap at once: if two teams in a heat die, the leftovers of other heats get mixed in, and the leftovers might be crawlers. So they help the stragglers. They tow Team Free Love, two bugbears whose van is burning, across the line. Carl realises the floor exists to purge awakened NPCs. Mordecai is a shadow mimic this time, wearing a Moon Reaper. Donut's godslayer box leaves her right paw glowing blue with claws that cut anything. Kills on this floor can be sent by audience vote to an arena on the eleventh floor, or replaced there by a stand-in from outside the dungeon.

beats.headline: Heats
beats.text: In the team roundabout they meet the neighbours: a pack of Razor Foxes called the Wild Hunt, led by Chiyome; two womantaur dominators with a half-mantaur in a gimp suit: Corcunda, or half of him, Dong's old friend. Carl says out loud that they will not tell Dong, and the dungeon gives him a quest to reunite the two halves. Hungry Eyes Village has neon, mystery meat and a bar called the Lollipop, where the survivors meet between heats. Prepotente asks Donut whether to feed his goat girlfriend a biscuit that makes whoever eats it fall in love with whoever feeds it, and she writes him rules to live by, rule one being don't. Carl teaches Bucket Boy, the crocodilian kid, to drive in an afternoon. In the second heat hail takes the awning off, and Team Sparkles, a unicorn in a tumbleweed with a rat on its head, puts a cannon through the car in front. A pig named Penelope rides on the back of One Fine Pig, protected by the god Taranis. The gatekeeper boss is a pair of level-170 spiked kangaroos. Their only weak spot is inside the pouch, and the clue is the dead joeys in it. Carl peels a joey skin off the engineer riding inside, hops into the pouch dressed as a kangaroo, drops two satchels and phases out. Every other team races off while the kangaroos die. The Royal Court finishes last, alive only because another team died first, and Carl cannot take the costume off for twelve hours.

beats.headline: The gods are out
beats.text: A gremlin hands Carl a note hidden under a dirty drawing. It is from Akuma, asking him to kill two teams in the next heat, and offering a meeting. The eleventh floor is announced: A Parade of Horribles, where the special guest creatures killed on this floor, or their stand-ins, will be waiting. Dong collapses outside the Dominators' garage, and Imani works out that his sapient sock-flail has been sustaining him, and that he is addicted to it. Rend wanders in front of Mordecai's Moon Reaper form, drops dead from a look, and comes back stronger and weak to potatoes. Then a show, Plenty of Plenty, where the caprids take turns asking questions. One goat explains what Justice Light did: he broke the Nothing and let everything inside it loose. Orren and Victory ask Carl to raise the integrity of the tunnels in their exact words. Instead he asks, out loud and live, whether the public knows the gods have escaped into their tunnels and that they are in worse danger than the crawlers. The AI lets it go out. The goats stampede, their matriarch weeps, and the AI kills Harbinger before he can shoot Carl. In the third heat Gluteus Maxx drives on Samantha's drugs, Donut's new throne answers to Dorota, and waves of sugar hermits break over the road. Donut builds a tunnel out of Temporary Macaroni. Chiyome's team is gone. Gluteus passes out at the wheel, Donut works the pedals with both paws, Carl lies on the hood and kicks a skull, and they cross the line first in pieces.

beats.headline: The Pineapple Cabaret
beats.text: They hire three mercenaries, team Helix: a grulke, a porsuk and a fire fairy called Quemada. Eris turns up with a toy Uzi Jesus on her shoulder. She offers to shield Carl from Emberus if he will worship her instead, tells him to work with Akuma, who has a way into something called the Pineapple Cabaret, and shows him a five-sided coin of possible futures. Carl snatches it out of the air, choosing chaos. At a diner Akuma finally talks, mostly because Elle has frozen and shattered one of his balls and is holding the other in reserve. The Pineapple Cabaret is a pocket dimension built by two former crawlers, Herot and Menerva, as a refuge for NPCs when floors collapse. It might lead out of the dungeon altogether, to Earth's surface. Nobody who worships a god may enter. The Scavenger's Daughter is somehow the key. Donut has to sing to get into a karaoke guild, and Mordecai starts brewing bard potions. Osvaldo's team joins their heat, hostile. In the fourth heat Quemada breaks down, awake at last to what she is after listening to Akuma. Cannibal Gingers drop out of the trees, and their chieftain sucks out Olga's soul. At the pit stop Finley carries his two unconscious teammates out to look for a healer, and One Fine Pig runs all three of them into the pavement, then backs up and does it again.

beats.headline: Satan's Water Park
beats.text: Carl loses control. He attacks One Fine Pig's armoured garage with his fists until its shield throws him into the street, and Donut and Imani drag him away. Then he makes a plan. While Donut charms the two tiger-men with a speech about doomed throuples, Carl lays two disintegration traps keyed to fire only on Tigrans, so the pig will be safe. Both Tigrans dissolve. One Fine Pig is eliminated, and whoever wins the heat gets the key to its garage, and the pig. So they need to win. Donut raises Olga's corpse, head caved in, to drive. The track is Satan's Water Park, a maze of slides and tubes with a kaiju hedgehog called Satan rampaging through it. In Carl's Book of Boom a crawler he never met, Mehmet, has left a spell called Gutter Bumper and a request to find his daughters. Carl lays it along a river packed with cannibals, Donut's Ice Slick freezes them solid, and the truck drags every spare weapon he owns across them on chains while summoned shrews finish the rest. They come in first. Florin has been harrying Team Sparkles down the tubes, and when Satan swats both teams off the loop, Lucienne of Sparkles is dragged onto the food truck's hood by Donut's vermin spell and crushed against the finish line barrier. Then Lucia looks at Carl, and the Scavenger's Daughter patch blinks. Chalchiuhtlicue is here, Lucia says.

beats.headline: Take On Me
beats.text: Samantha knows the goddess they decide to call Chachi: pretty, weepy, always talking about saving children, and quick to sacrifice one when it is convenient. Carl collects Penelope from One Fine Pig's empty garage. Li Na has gone mad, and Zhang means to kill their mount and take them both out of the race. Carl sees another way. Mordecai and Rosetta test an exploit in the shop, using a cleaner bot to post a crawler through the wall into the Cabaret, where Herot has a standing order for every cleaner bot sold. Menerva is on the seventeenth floor. Getting into the karaoke guild means singing a song perfectly, so Carl drinks every potion Mordecai can compound and sings Take On Me with Donut. A drunk Dwight stabs the DJ, the bar erupts, Dong's sock explodes into coins, and Carl hits the high note. A kappa knocks Donut over on her last line, and only Carl gets in. Inside, the guildmaster is Porky, the other half of Corcunda, and he agrees to be reunited. Dong is cursed with something called Negative ROI now that the sock has run off, and Carl apologises for leaving him out. Then Li Na climbs into an extra-large pet carrier, the cleaner bot sucks her up, Louis names the bot Suckira, and Donut sells it. Li Na leaves behind a cactus tied to her life.

beats.headline: Half a prayer, half a song
beats.text: The fifth heat runs through a gasworks, a steel mill and a doll workshop. Carl blows the tommy gun off the roof to see where he is going, follows the Dominators onto a conveyor belt over the melting vats, and discovers the untested rocket button. Prepotente's goat Bianca, sent to snatch Corky out of the Dominators' car, gets strung out on toddler cocaine. The Dominators fall through a trap into a pit of cocaine-elemental dolls, and Donut drops in, lands on their car and Puddle Jumps Corky out. Then Carl drives upside down along the ceiling over a river of molten steel while Grigori the fleshmancer, vomiting, stitches the two halves of Corcunda together in the back. The ritual works, and the moment Corky is one man again, Grull arrives to smite him, driven by the Maestro. Donut's Laundry Day drops the Maestro out of the god's chest into the molten metal. But Corcunda is still marked, and he decides to go to meet the god rather than let it kill everyone with him. He tells Dong he loves him. Dong says he will never leave him again, and they go out the back of the truck together. Donut casts Big-Ass Magnet on Dong's lance, and every screw in the factory goes with them. Grull is sent back to the twelfth floor, and Dong does not come back. They cross the line with fifteen seconds to spare. The AI admits it no longer knows what is happening in parts of its own dungeon. On the cactus, a single flower opens. Li Na made it.

beats.headline: What-ifs
beats.text: In the pet stables, where the gods cannot hear, they make the plan. Two hundred crawlers will go to the Cabaret by cleaner bot. Everyone else should take a deal. Carl will leave Donut's party on the eleventh floor to deal with Emberus, because Hellik has to be dead by then or Carl is smitten. Donut stops speaking to him. Rosetta tells them what she knows of the Scavenger. Nekhebit had three children: Apito, Scolopendra and a son. Any of them has been called the Scavenger in one myth or another, and whoever the Scavenger's Daughter is, she can take the powers of gods for herself. At the farewell in the square, Elle's superfan Linus is unmasked by her fan club as his twin, Minus, an assassin sent in to kill Imani and Louis. The two hundred go through, and the guild grows a garden of potted plants, one tied to each of their lives. The sixth race runs through a building of shrunken apartments, each one a what-if for a crawler the AI finds interesting: Tran's family if his father had lived, Louis thinner and graduated, Imani's uncle dying on the carpet, Prepotente's mother as a concert pianist who never had him. When a shell tears its stitches open, beetles pour out. With Osvaldo claiming he is about to finish, Carl detonates a can he slipped into Team Free Love's cooler earlier, killing the two bugbears he once towed across a finish line. At Miriam's piano he talks Prepotente back onto his mount. Carl, you may call me Pony.

beats.headline: The last heat
beats.text: Fewer than a thousand crawlers are left, and the Outreach Guild opens for deals. Osvaldo refuses one. Britney speaks straight into Carl's mind, telling him not to worry about her. The Nothing spaces on the casino wheel now have quotation marks around them. The last heat puts crawlers against crawlers after all: Chris against Imani and Elle, Louis and Britney against Florin and Lucia. Then Scolopendra releases the first of her nine attacks. Carl's roll comes up red, and he is a long-haired dachshund. Contingency three: every crawler team in a mixed heat kills its NPC opponents at the start line, Donut takes Dwight's head in one swipe, and Carl's poleaxe charges punch a shaft through the apartment building to the portals on the roof. Osvaldo runs for the exit and Britney kills him, taking Ysalte's memorial crystal. For the crawlers who cannot all finish, they try the casino. A bribed croupier spins the wheel, Chris steps into the Nothing, and Britney jumps in after him. Every piece of furniture in the room is a shadow mimic. The Eye of the Bedlam Bride tries to open on the dog's forehead, and the AI stops mid-fight to explain the six powers fighting over its dungeon: crawlers, NPCs, gods, sapient mobs, the demons of Sheol, and a sixth group they will meet below. Imani holds the portal open while Louis and the rest of the mixed heats go through, and Carl promises every one of them that he will get them out. Then the survivors cross the line and take the stairs.
